rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a part or rate expressed out of 100.

example.english: The percentage of students who passed the exam has gone up.
example.traditional: 今次考試合格嘅學生百分比高咗。
example.jyutping: gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 hap6 gaak3 ge3 hok6 saang1 baak3 fan6 bei2 gou1 zo2

rows.note: Use this when the percentage means commission paid for making a sale or arranging a deal.

example.english: I will get a percentage because I referred the customer to them.
example.traditional: 個客係我介紹畀佢嘅，所以我會有佣金。
example.jyutping: go3 haak3 hai6 ngo5 gaai3 siu6 bei2 keoi5 ge3 so2 ji5 ngo5 wui5 jau5 jung2 gam1

rows.note: Use this for a percentage cut taken from sales, profits, or other business revenue, especially when describing the arrangement rather than the payment.

example.english: This platform takes a high percentage, taking thirty percent from every item sold.
example.traditional: 呢間平台抽成好高，每賣一件貨就抽三成。
example.jyutping: ne1 gaan1 ping4 toi1 cau1 sing4 hou2 gou1 mui5 maai6 jat1 gin6 fo3 zau6 cau1 saam1 sing4
